mia (AP): Invoice from SummitBridge INV-6599 uploaded, amount $11,400, no PO field detected. PDF attached.
accounts-bot: New invoice INV-6599.pdf (vendor SB-410) parsed $11,400 - OCR hint 'PO: 6600' (LOW_CONF).
ben (Finance Ops): @olga can you search POs for SB-410? This looks like evaluation work.
olga (Procurement): Found PO-6600 but it's assigned to Redwood-EMEA (GL 5420) and closed. There's PO-8800 active for US but different SOW.
mia (AP): Invoice billed to Redwood-US / GL 5403 - that's blocking autoplace.
kevin (ML Eng): SummitBridge did prompt tuning for US search (TICKET: SEARCH-122). We have SOW SB-SOW-77 referencing PO-6600.
tara (Eng Manager): Confirming deliverables for US. I can approve payment if needed.
olga (Procurement): Options: reassign PO-6600 to US (procurement change, 3 days) or process Non-PO Payment Request (NPR) with manager approval.
ben (Finance Ops): Vendor due date 2026-03-24. If time-sensitive, do NPR and later do intercompany journal.
vendor-bot: Vendor master SB-410 - SummitBridge Inc - Tax ID SB-US-44 - Default entity Redwood-EU - Default remit EUR IBAN.
kevin (ML Eng): They accepted USD wire per email SOW, attaching snippet.
tara (Eng Manager): Attached. Approved payment from US ledger. Charge SEARCH-122. Comment: "Approve Tara - SEARCH-122"
mia (AP): Creating NPR-10021 routing to tara, procurement, AP. Link: https://redwood/payments/NPR-10021
accounts-bot: NPR-10021 status: pending approval from tara.
accounts-bot: tara approved NPR-10021.
mia (AP): Scheduling USD wire, flagging tax review for procurement.
olga (Procurement): Created ticket PROC-4991 to review PO ownership and add USD remit to vendor master. ETA 3 business days.
vendor-bot: NPR-10021 paid 2026-03-18 - REF SB-WIRE-9001.
ben (Finance Ops): Remittance received. Follow-up: procurement to reconcile intercompany and update PO mapping.
kevin (ML Eng): Will ensure future SOWs include PO and GL info to avoid OCR misses.
accounts-bot: Thread closed.
